{{Top|leg}}
A '''poison detector''' was a personal device capable of detecting [[Poison/Legends|poisons]]. [[Vanel (Human)|Vanel]], a former member of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], carried a poison detector about her person.
